retraction.reason: Retracted in M21: a routine election of the rotativismo, the arranged alternation of Regenerators and Progressives under the constitutional monarchy. Held 30 March 1890; the Regenerators won 115 seats. The cached lead gives the date and the seat count and nothing more, and the atlas holds no event between 1890 and 1910 that this result can be argued to have changed. It could not be wired without inventing the argument.
